scope: the three B02 RequestContract obligations, stated generically by operation kind and measured subject; no problem-specific names

layers.COMPUTATION_COVERAGE: witness produced by exactly one `measure` of the obligation's quantity with correctly typed operands, and realised as an exact number in final_memory
layers.CONSTRUCTION_COVERAGE: each measured subject is written by exactly one program statement (or declared with an initial value); a registered/contract section requirement demands `construct_section`
layers.SCENE_COVERAGE: each measured subject is a scene object; a section requirement demands type `section`, closed polygon, matching cycle and matching source plane when a reference exists
layers.ANSWER_COVERAGE: display of the witness equals the registered answer and the scene readout for the witness

computation.pass_criterion: measure(volume, of=solid) produces the witness; exact value in final_memory
computation.current_gate_checks: YES — C₁a witness derivation; C₂ check_volume volume_of(container) == witness
computation.false_positive_risk: LOW — kernel volume of the named solid

construction.current_gate_checks: PARTIAL — C₁a requires the container to exist with an accepted type, not how it was built
construction.false_positive_risk: MEDIUM — a solid with wrong vertices still yields a self-consistent volume unless the contract declares a value

scene.pass_criterion: scene object of type solid for the subject
scene.false_positive_risk: LOW — Polyhedron values always become solid objects

answer.pass_criterion: display == registered answer and scene readout
answer.current_gate_checks: NO for B02 (contract has no value)

rows.measured_subject_kind: planar figure (polygon3 | section | circle3 | ellipse3); registered requirement: section

computation.pass_criterion: measure(area, of=subject) produces the witness; exact value in final_memory
computation.current_gate_checks: YES — C₁a; C₂ check_area area_of(container) == witness
computation.false_positive_risk: HIGH as a proxy for the section — any planar figure with a self-consistent area passes

construction.current_gate_checks: NO — area accepts construct_polygon subjects; section_matches (absent here) accepts polygon3
construction.false_positive_risk: HIGH — reproduced offline: base-square polygon and section-coordinate polygon are both served

scene.pass_criterion: scene object of type section, closed, cycle equal to the reference, source plane equal to the reference plane
scene.false_positive_risk: HIGH at route level; the scene builder itself never labels a polygon as section

answer.pass_criterion: display == registered answer and scene readout
answer.false_positive_risk: HIGH — reproduced: the registered area from a figure that is not the section

computation.pass_criterion: measure(distance, of=point, wrt=line) produces the witness; exact value in final_memory

construction.pass_criterion: point and line each written by a statement (declare_point, construct_line)
construction.current_gate_checks: PARTIAL — grounding checks declared coordinates; line construction not compared with the problem

scene.pass_criterion: scene objects for point and line

answer.pass_criterion: display == registered answer and scene readout

generalisation: requirements are attached by obligation pointer, not by name: from a contract section_matches on the same container (REQUEST_CONTRACT) or from a pre-registered evaluation reference (REGISTERED_REFERENCE)
